exposure: trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
cohort: 125 women with a bicornuate uterus and a previous low-segment transverse cesarean delivery who attempted TOLAC, compared to a group with non-malformed uteri, from two university-affiliated centers between 2005 and 2021
finding: Parturients with a bicornuate uterus who attempted TOLAC have a relatively high overall rate of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC), but significantly lower chances of achieving VBAC compared to those with a non-malformed uterus.
